content: Tapanea Maro Kindeni tasuka i ŋa kâki
Tapanea Yova Kindeni tasuka i ŋa kâki! Miki ŋine kala kamo Yova Kindeni ne luma sapâŋa ilo, miki kapanea i! Mao nâ, kapanea i kala uru imo samba lawea kaika ŋinde ilo!
Ina uru iveta vetâŋa ŋalaŋala kie-kie, aku i ŋa tava ne walo kaika nde ŋalae ndo, ipole kelekele rârâni marumbu lâ. Mine nde miki kapanea i ŋa kasuka kâki!
Kambana nemi tando wa kara nemi wâŋgu kie-kie, ku kapanea i ŋa kasuka kâki!
Kara nemi wâŋgu, aku kaki kapanea i ŋa kasuka kâki! Kara nemi wâŋgu ŋalaŋala wa kambana kauro wa, ku kapanea i ŋa kasuka kâki!
Kara nemi kondo “aini” kiri-kiri wa ŋalaŋala wa, aku kaveta ne nduŋeŋani ipâŋga ŋalae ilâ ŋana kapanea Maro Kindeni ŋa kasuka kâki!
Miki kelekele rârâni kamo viami, miki kapanea Yova Kindeni ŋa kasuka kâki! Tapanea Yova Kindeni ŋa tasuka kâki!
